name: ChatGPT Work
notes: ChatGPT Work is OpenAI's mode for delegating tasks inside ChatGPT: it breaks a goal into steps and uses files, plugins, approved tools and a browser to deliver reviewable docs, analyses, recurring updates and workflows, on the web and in the ChatGPT desktop app. Requested via the form (issue #183).
tagline: A way to delegate real work to ChatGPT.

access.price: Included with ChatGPT Plus ($20/mo), Pro, Business and Enterprise/Edu
